title: Comparison of Motivic Homotopy Theories
summary: We construct a comparison functor from the dual category of motivic homotopy category $\mathcal{SH}$ to the category of $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant localizing motives $\operatorname{Mot}_{\operatorname{loc}}^{\mathbb{A}^1}$ in the sense of Blumberg, Gepner and Tabuada (with $\mathbb{A}^1$-invariance imposed). We as well construct its non-$\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant analogue: a functor from the dual category of Annala-Iwasa-Hoyois's non-$\mathbb{A}^1$-invariant motivic homotopy category $\mathcal{MS}$ to $\operatorname{Mot}_{\operatorname{loc}}$.
